picks.headline: I saw Microsoft Surface laptops with the Snapdragon X2, and this is what AI PCs should feel like
picks.excerpt: I tried Microsoft’s new Snapdragon-powered Surface PCs and saw local AI turn sketches into 3D models, images and videos, while new haptics and Ink Canvas made the experience feel surprisingly intuitive.
picks.rationale: Hands-on with on-device sketch-to-3D/image/video and Ink Canvas on new Surface hardware; the most designer-actionable item, distinct from the 09-26 Copilot+ PC policy card.

picks.headline: Meta brings FDA-cleared hearing enhancement to its smart glasses
picks.excerpt: After a free trial it'll cost $150 to add on, or require a Meta One subscription.
picks.rationale: New regulated health feature on AI glasses with concrete pricing; not covered by prior Meta Muse/privacy/Connect cards.

picks.headline: "The refrigerator is dead": Samsung's AI fridges shut down after update, causes outrage
picks.excerpt: Samsung has stopped a SmartThings update after Bespoke AI 4-Door fridges shut down when it was installed. As per reports, internal test software reached customers by mistake. Samsung has apologized and will send engineers over the Chuseok break.
picks.rationale: Concrete failure case for connected AI appliances; a sharp lesson for anyone designing update/fallback UX; fresh story with no prior coverage.

picks.headline: An Asus homage to legendary Apple Mac Pro: GB300 DGX workstation gets two thumbs up from reviewer who calls $120,000 AI supercomputer 'the most capable thing we’ve ever put on a desk'
picks.excerpt: This machine runs hundreds of AI agents at once, and somehow keeps every single one responsive
picks.rationale: Freshest hardware item: desk-side GB300 box running hundreds of local agents, with industrial-design angle; distinct from the 09-27 PixelMob review.

picks.headline: I turned my Android phone’s annoying AI button into its most powerful shortcut key
picks.excerpt: I was ready to disable my AI button until I realized how much it could actually do.
picks.rationale: Directly actionable how-to for repurposing the hardware AI key; fifth distinct outlet, no prior coverage.
